title: Brett Veach: There will probably be a lot of trades in first round of the draft

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Chiefs GM expecting a lot of trades in first round
sources.description: Chiefs general manager Brett Veach said Thursday that there will "probably be a lot of trades" in the first round of this year's NFL draft.

sources.description: At least one General Manager is expecting some significant movement during the first round of the draft next week.
